Thanks — Peter here (Holden IT). Wed 10:00 PT is 13:00 ET for me and that works. A few asks from our side so we can be efficient:

1) Please include a short summary of the network ports and outbound endpoints (or point me to the doc).
2) We'll want to review token retention and KV cache behavior relative to PHI — if you can highlight those items that would be helpful.
3) If you have a short pre-demo checklist (SAML/SOC2 items) please drop it in the invite so we can loop in our security engineer if needed.

If you want to do the longer 55–60 minute slot, that would give us time to walk through the checklist. Otherwise 45 is ok but we'll prioritize the network + retention topics.
